mapper.insert: INSERT INTO price_history (stock_code, interval_type, trade_datetime, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, volume) VALUES (#{stockCode}, #{intervalType}, #{tradeDateTime}, #{open}, #{high}, #{low}, #{close}, #{volume}) ON CONFLICT (stock_code, interval_type, trade_datetime) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL DO UPDATE SET open_price = EXCLUDED.open_price, high_price = EXCLUDED.high_price, low_price = EXCLUDED.low_price, close_price = EXCLUDED.close_price, volume = EXCLUDED.volume, updated_at = now()
